# Recipes

<!-- recipes:generated -->

Component requirements for every item that is assembled from other items, grouped by category (see [Production](/features/production/) in the features section). **Research level** is the maximum research level the item has — higher levels change yield/calibration, not the component list. Each item has its own page with its stats, the items it is a component of, and the vendors that sell it.
